risky_clauses.title: Unilateral Customer Work Product Assignment
risky_clauses.summary: Customer irrevocably assigns all right, title, and interest in any inventions or code modifications created that interact with Provider API, even if created independently.

risky_clauses.title: Unlimited Customer Indemnity
risky_clauses.summary: Customer must indemnify Provider for any third-party claim relating to Services without cap, regardless of Provider's negligence or fault.

risky_clauses.title: Provider Liability Cap ($50.00)
risky_clauses.summary: Provider's aggregate liability capped at only $50 USD even in cases of gross negligence.

obligations: Provider must encrypt data at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)
Customer must pay invoices net 30 days
Customer retains ownership of underlying customer data
reply_email_rubric: Rejects unilateral IP assignment in Section 4.1
Rejects unlimited indemnity in Section 5.1 and demands mutual cap
Demands increase of Provider liability cap in Section 5.2 from $50 to at least 12 months fees
Professional commercial tone with clear counter-proposals
